title: Add RAG Compact Studio CLI Playground
author: Priya Nambiar
description: Introduce a lightweight, local-first CLI quickstart called 'Compact Studio' that demonstrates a compact retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow optimized for fast iteration. The quickstart includes: a small Node.js CLI shim to run agent templates, two example agent manifests (tool-calling and structured-output), an incremental local indexer (file-backed), embedded prompt snippets for reproducible evals, a step-replay harness for deterministic debugging, and a set of telemetry probes that emit token-level latency and reranking metrics. Motivation: enable engineers to prototype RAG agents without spinning up full infra, make telemetry-first design visible early, and provide repeatable acceptance checks for structured outputs. This PR adds the quickstart, docs/guide, a devcontainer for reproducible local setup, CI smoke tests, and sample datasets. The description below lists changes, tests, review notes, and merge outcome.

release_notes: Adds a local-first RAG Compact Studio CLI quickstart with example agents, embedded prompts, telemetry probes, a step-replay harness, and devcontainer for reproducible local development. Good for prototyping agent patterns and collecting early telemetry.
notes_on_testing: Manual steps: run scripts/start-local.sh to create corpus and index, then npm run start in quickstarts/compact-studio-cli to exercise the CLI runner.
